items.text: Ridiculous QUESTIONABLE list this week (Chase/Higgins, Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, Caleb Williams, McConkey, Flowers, Stevenson, McLaurin, Kamara etc.); bracing for messy Sunday morning actives.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Friday board; many key players listed Q.
items.implication: High variance Sunday; monitor morning reports closely for start/sit.
items.opportunity: If OUT, beneficiaries in respective rooms (e.g. Bengals WRs, Vikings, etc.).

items.text: Saquon Barkley ruled OUT for Week 5 (hamstring) along with Tank Bigsby and DeVonta Smith; Eagles RB room thinned significantly for London game vs JAX.
items.why: Final injury report; missed practice all week after Week 4 hamstring.
items.implication: Major loss of volume for PHI offense; backup RBs elevated for heavy role.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries/red-zone to remaining PHI RBs (Shipley primary per reports).

items.text: Lamar Jackson ruled OUT (ankle) for Sunday night vs ATL; also Trey Hendrickson and Cam Jurgens out.
items.why: Missed practice midweek after exiting Week 4 early; official designation.
items.implication: Ravens offense without dual-threat QB; backup starts, Flowers/Andrews usage shifts possible.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for Zay Flowers and TEs if game script allows.

items.text: Stefon Diggs OUT (hamstring); Jayden Daniels will start vs Giants.
items.why: Official report; Daniels upgraded after full practice and cleared to start.
items.implication: Commanders WR corps thinned; Daniels return boosts overall offense.
items.opportunity: More targets for Terry McLaurin/Deebo if active; Daniels rushing/passing volume back.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) for Week 5 vs CLE; AD Mitchell also out.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps for remaining NYJ RBs.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love not on final injury report (ankle maintenance); projects 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier with expected better role after Week 4 usage criticism.
items.why: Full-go comments + not on report; prior drag from media/fans may force more work; downside still accounted for.
items.implication: Clear RB1 path and higher workload projection vs DET.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/snaps/routes expected; 4.8-point edge over backup.

items.text: Chargers ruled out WR Quentin Johnston (among others including OT Joe Alt, S Derwin James).
items.implication: LAC WR targets redistribute; Ladd McConkey primary.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Ladd McConkey and remaining WRs.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red-zone vs soft Titans pass D.
items.why: Target hog + RZ usage + matchup gift.
items.opportunity: High target/route share expected to continue.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; 'Brown Gobbler' nickname push for target/fantasy gobbling; Bengals WR injuries may boost.
items.why: Workload + soft MIA run D + potential pass-game bump if Chase/Higgins limited.

items.text: Mike Evans off injury report, no designation (clear); 49ers also OUT Juszczyk/Bosa. Dallas Goedert IN per ETR.
items.why: Official clear for Evans; Goedert full practice progression.
items.implication: Full go for both; SF WR1 and PHI TE1 locked in.

items.text: Broncos place emerging WR Pat Bryant on short-term IR (ankle); misses next four, return as soon as Nov 8 vs CAR. Lil'Jordan Humphrey promoted.
items.why: Ankle from Week 4; short-term IR designation.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term (sore knee + lingering shoulder + potential JJ McCarthy + boomer coaching); frustration over low second-half targets noted. Good this week but stacked risks later.
items.why: Knee DNP + shoulder history + QB/coaching changes possible; expressed target frustration.
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; short-term playable but volatility high.

items.text: Hates Jalen Hurts vs JAX in London (QB15); rough stretch + banged-up line.
items.why: Recent form + OL issues + London travel/Barkley-Smith outs.
items.implication: Fade or lower ranking this week.
items.conflict: Barkley/Smith outs could force more Hurts rushing, but Berry still fades.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5) on volume/matchup/coverage spots.
items.why: Target volume + RZ + specific D weaknesses.
